Horse_Flowing_Tail.description: The flowing tail, a mesmerizing appendage that undulates with an otherworldly grace, enhances the charisma and agility of its bearer, granting a subtle yet captivating charm that entrances all who behold it.

Pig_Curly_Tail.description: The Pig_Curly_Tail, a whimsical yet functional appendage, adds a playful twist to agility, coiling and uncoiling with fluid grace, enhancing its bearer's nimbleness and dexterity in the most unexpected ways.

Cow_Tufted_Fly_Swatter.description: A sleek, tufted appendage sprouting from the base of an ungulate's tail, this swatter enhances agility and evasion, granting its wielder a natural edge in nimble movements and quick escapes.

Zebra_Striped_Tail.description: The Zebra-Striped Tail, a vibrant and agile appendage, swishes with a mesmerizing rhythm, enhancing its bearer's evasion and charm while confusing foes with its hypnotic patterns.

Goat_Short_Upright_Tail.description: This short, upright tail, sprouting from the back of ungulate creatures, enhances their natural agility and dexterity, providing a subtle but crucial balance and control in swift movements and acrobatic feats.

Deer_White_Flagging_Tail.description: The White Flagging Tail is a striking appendage, a vibrant patch of snow-white fur at the end of a slender tail that flutters with each graceful movement, enhancing agility and charisma while subtly alerting predators to the bearer's presence in the dense underbrush.

Giraffe_Long_Tufted_Tail.description: This long, tufted tail, a natural extension of the giraffe's regal form, enhances its reach and agility, serving both as a defensive weapon and a delicate balancing tool, perfectly adapted for life among the treetops.

Hippopotamus_Stout_Flat_Tail.description: The hippopotamus's stout flat tail, a powerful appendage that propels its massive ungulate body with unparalleled grace through aquatic realms, enhances its constitution, granting resilience and the ability to perform a swift and devastating Swim Dash that can knock back foes in the water.

Zombie_Boar_Rotting_Tail.description: This rotting tail, a grotesque appendage from the corpse of a once-proud boar, writhes with an undead vitality, its tattered flesh and exposed bones a testament to its corrupted nature, granting its bearer a twisted resilience to poison while simultaneously sapping the wielder's charisma.

Ghost_Steed_Ethereal_Tail.description: This spectral tail, a hauntingly elegant appendage from an otherworldly steed, pulses with ethereal magic that enhances its bearer’s wisdom and evasion, allowing them to move with ghostly grace and vanish from sight at will.
